name: Coolify
description: 自建专属的开源 Heroku / Vercel 替代品，单条命令即可在百元 VPS 上搭建，无缝自动化部署 GitHub 仓库、Docker 容器与各类数据库。
descriptionEn: An open-source, self-hostable Heroku & Vercel alternative. Effortlessly deploy Git repositories, Docker containers, and databases to your own VPS.
warningText: 自建版完全免费且无任何商业节点限制。推荐配合 2GB 内存以上的 Debian/Ubuntu 云主机使用。
warningTextEn: Self-hosted version is 100% free with unlimited servers and deployments. A 2GB+ RAM Linux VPS is recommended.

name: Bruno
description: 开源且革命性的 API 调试客户端，完全替代日益臃肿且强制云端同步的 Postman。所有请求集合直接存为本地 Git 纯文本文件。
descriptionEn: Fast, Git-friendly open-source API client disrupting Postman's cloud lock-in. Saves API collections as readable local files directly in your repo.
warningText: 完全离线保存，杜绝企业机密接口被云端外泄风险。基础全功能永久开源免费。
warningTextEn: Stores everything locally on disk without forced cloud logins. Ideal for sensitive corporate APIs and team versioning via Git.

name: Uptime Kuma
description: 高颜值自建服务状态监控面板，替代商业的 UptimeRobot。支持 HTTP(s)、Ping、DNS、Docker 监控，并可通过 Telegram/邮件/微信即时报警。
descriptionEn: A fancy, lightweight self-hosted uptime monitoring tool alternative to UptimeRobot. Monitors HTTP, Ping, DNS, Docker with Telegram, Discord, and Slack alerts.
warningText: 非常轻量（单容器仅需几十兆内存）。建议搭配反向代理配置 HTTPS 证书后公开状态页。
warningTextEn: Extremely resource-efficient (consumes merely dozens of MBs in a single Docker container). Deploy behind a reverse proxy for public status pages.

name: VSCodium
description: 真正自由且纯净的 VS Code 二进制构建版本，彻底剥离了微软官方闭源二进制包中的遥测追踪、数据采集与专属受限协议。
descriptionEn: Community-driven, freely-licensed binary distributions of Microsoft's editor VS Code with telemetry and tracking completely purged.
warningText: 纯开源无广告。默认使用开放的 Open VSX 插件市场，极少数微软私有专有插件（如 Pylance）可选用开源替代方案。
warningTextEn: Uses the open Open VSX extension registry by default. Pure FOSS with zero background telemetry beacons.

name: CyberChef
description: 网络瑞士军刀，支持数据编解码、加解密、Base64/Hex/JSON 格式化、正则表达式解析、压缩提取等 300+ 种离线运算流水线。
descriptionEn: The Cyber Swiss Army Knife. A web app for encryption, encoding, compression, and data analysis in an interactive pipeline running 100% locally in browser.
warningText: 纯前端运算，所有敏感数据均在本地浏览器内存中计算，绝不会上传网络，可直接离线保存单 HTML 文件使用。
warningTextEn: Pure client-side execution. Sensitive tokens, keys, and payloads never leave browser memory; can be downloaded as a standalone offline HTML file.
